value.raw_question: APM di Papua Pegunungan berapa persen?

value.sql:
SELECT T1.nama AS wilayah, T1.periode, T2.nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND T2.periode = :periode
  AND T2.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY T2.nilai DESC;

value.sql:
SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    nilai_indikator.periode AS periode,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS total_indikator,
    (SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai), 0)) AS persen
FROM 
    provinsi
JOIN 
    nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama, nilai_indikator.periode
ORDER BY 
    total_indikator DESC;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, nilai_indikator.nilai AS nilai
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS nilai
FROM 
    nilai_indikator
JOIN 
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE 
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY 
    provinsi.nama
ORDER BY 
    nilai DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.nama AS wilayah, T2.periode, T2.nilai
FROM provinsi AS T1
JOIN nilai_indikator AS T2 ON T1.kode = T2.kode_provinsi
WHERE T2.kode_indikator = :indikator
AND T2.periode = :periode
AND T1.kode IN (:wilayah_0)
ORDER BY T2.nilai DESC; -- assuming you want to rank by descending order

SELECT
  provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
  periode,
  SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100.0 / MAX(nilai_indikator.nilai) AS persen
FROM
  provinsi
JOIN
  nilai_indikator
ON
  provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE
  nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
  provinsi.nama,
  periode

SELECT
    provinsi.nama AS wilayah,
    periode,
    SUM(nilai) AS nilai
FROM
    nilai_indikator
JOIN
    provinsi ON nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi = provinsi.kode
WHERE
    nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
    AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
    AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY
    provinsi.nama, periode
ORDER BY
    nilai DESC;

SELECT provinsi.nama AS wilayah, SUM(nilai_indikator.nilai) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS nilai_persen
FROM provinsi
JOIN nilai_indikator ON provinsi.kode = nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi
WHERE nilai_indikator.kode_indikator = :indikator
  AND nilai_indikator.periode = :periode
  AND nilai_indikator.kode_provinsi IN (:wilayah_0)
GROUP BY provinsi.kode
ORDER BY nilai_persen DESC
LIMIT 1;
